negatives.claim: A 13,217-parameter 3-width (6/20/75) conv encoder over 150 bp peak tiles beats a single GC feature on genomic promoter-tile activity
negatives.scope: A 13,217-parameter conv at THREE kernel widths (6/20/75) over 150 bp peak tiles -- ~1 decade of range. The proposal specifies 1 bp/16 bp/128 bp/1 kb/10 kb over 1 Mb (FOUR decades), which a 150 bp tile cannot host at all, so the proposed arm is UNRUNNABLE on this substrate rather than merely unrun.
negatives.revival_condition: the 4-decade pyramid is run on a substrate with >=3 decades of available range (a longer genomic window, or a constructed eukaryotic/human panel)

negatives.claim: BLOSUM62 and ESM2-650M likelihood both rank the resistant residue as benign at catalogued PATHOGEN TARGET-SITE positions ONLY -- HIV-1 RT, SARS-CoV-2 Mpro and fungal ERG11/FKS1
negatives.scope: PATHOGEN TARGET-SITE resistance systems ONLY -- three pathogens, catalogued resistance positions, scored by mid-rank of the resistant residue among the 19 alternatives (pooled 4.5 of 19 vs a null of 10.0, n=139). DRM sites sit at ESM entropy percentile 0.494, i.e. exactly average, which REFUTES the usual 'the site is poorly conserved' account. Friedman 2013 (PLOS ONE 8:e82059) supplies a COUNTEREXAMPLE CLASS: EGFR and ALK resistance mutations tend to be RADICAL, so this must not be stated as a general law.
negatives.revival_condition: a conservation- or likelihood-keyed scorer is tested on a resistance system OUTSIDE pathogen target sites (e.g. kinase-inhibitor resistance), where the published counterexample class lives
negatives.claim_corrected_from: BLOSUM62 and ESM2-650M likelihood both rank the resistant residue as benign at catalogued target sites in HIV-1 RT, SARS-CoV-2 Mpro and fungal ERG11/FKS1
negatives.claim_correction_reason: 2026-10-09 the WIDENED peer detector caught this one: scope said ONLY, claim did not carry it

negatives.claim: FROZEN PlantCaduceus_l32 embeddings, used ZERO-SHOT as fixed features on 1,003 NATURAL Arabidopsis accessions, predict flowering time ONLY at or below a population-structure baseline
negatives.scope: One eukaryote, one trait (FT10), 3 seeds, n=1003 NATURAL accessions -- a natural population, which is the regime this project has measured as closed FOR EVERY ORGANISM. Within-group r-squared was NEGATIVE (-0.13 avg) and spearman 0.22 against a structure-only 0.48, i.e. the embedding learned POPULATION STRUCTURE rather than the causal signal. This is NOT evidence that eukaryotes are harder: the only clean organism-level positive in this project is also a eukaryote (yeast segregant cross, 12/12 traits at r 0.46-0.80) on a CONSTRUCTED panel.
negatives.revival_condition: a learned representation is tested on a CONSTRUCTED eukaryotic panel (a segregant cross, a MAGIC/NAM population, or a mutagenesis library) where ancestry is randomised by design rather than on natural accessions

negatives.claim: A CURATED-DETERMINANT alphabet beats a FIXED TOP-N K-MER VOCABULARY on 5 drugs (p<0.0001) -- a comparison in which NO learned representation was trained
negatives.scope: The losing arm was a FIXED top-N-most-frequent k-mer vocabulary used as the stand-in for a learned representation; the probe TRAINED NOTHING ('neural #3' appears once in the closeout, as the thing not done). The same document explains WHY that arm lost: the top-N k-mer vocab IS the core genome, so it misses signal WITHIN a lineage -- a VOCABULARY-CONSTRUCTION failure, not a learning failure. Headroom was also measured only on mechanisms the catalog already covers, while the project's own doubt layer later located the catalog's real gap as COMPLETENESS (V179F: 15/15 carriers resistant, rule says S) -- exactly where a learned model would earn its keep, and exactly where this probe never looked.
negatives.revival_condition: a learned representation is ACTUALLY TRAINED on raw sequence and compared to the curated alphabet, scored on the catalog's COMPLETENESS gap rather than on mechanisms the catalog already covers

negatives.claim: FROZEN pretrained nucleotide embeddings, used ZERO-SHOT as FIXED FEATURES on NATURAL populations, fail de-confounded organism-level g->p prediction (0-for-5)
negatives.scope: FIVE instantiations, all sharing the SAME four qualifiers: frozen weights, zero-shot, used as fixed features, and scored on NATURAL populations with a de-confounding control (within-lineage or within-group). Instances span bacteria (cipro within-lineage), pathotype, Arabidopsis flowering time, and dog/Drosophila panels. NONE of the five fine-tuned anything, and NONE used a constructed panel. This was originally filed as 'a MODEL ceiling' -- a claim about the whole class -- and that wording cost ~4 months.
negatives.revival_condition: any of the four shared qualifiers is broken: a FINE-TUNED representation, or a CONSTRUCTED panel where ancestry is randomised by design (the yeast segregant cross is the measured positive in this class), or a learned head rather than fixed features
